_comment: Everything that is specific to SVG 2. A module under specs/ gets its own file next to this one.

typed_link_policy._comment: exact: typed only when Bikeshed lands on the same id. section: also when it lands on the generated dfn in the same section (element summary box, IDL block).

_comment_front_matter: header_include: the front page (Overview.html) up to its table of contents becomes Bikeshed's header.include (Local Boilerplate: header yes), so the W3C status, patent and process text and links stay exactly as today. head_html is today's <head> (tools/publish/processing.js insertStyleSheets, MathJax); body_end_html is the script the old single page adds at the end.
_comment_single_page_drop_headings: Headings Bikeshed writes that today's single page does not have (the 'IDL Index' heading above the IDL appendix). singlepage.py replaces each by an empty span keeping its id, and drops its table of contents entry. Same list as drop_headings in config/svg2-split.json.
copyright_html: Copyright © [YEAR] World Wide Web Consortium. W3C® liability, trademark and permissive document license rules apply.

class_renames._comment: Bikeshed rewrites the first row of any table.propdef and drops the dfn there (and its id). SVG keeps its own property index page, so the class is renamed.

extra_css: /* Bikeshed draws <...> around element links; SVG 2 already puts curly quotes around them. */

metadata.Markup Shorthands: css no, dfn no, biblio no, markdown-block no, markdown-inline no, markdown-escapes no, markup no, http no, idl no, cddl no, algorithm no, repository-links no, macros-in-autolinks no
metadata.Complain About: accidental-2119 no, missing-example-ids no, mixed-indents no

_comment_idl_keyword_links: IDL keywords Bikeshed writes as plain text that today's spec links (keyword -> target id). idlkeywords.py adds the links after Bikeshed, inside IDL blocks only. Remove when speced/bikeshed#670 lands.

_comment_anchors: Lines of a Bikeshed <pre class=anchors> block. They pin the IDL links Bikeshed resolves through its own data to the targets today's spec uses (for example SVGPoint to geometry-1 #dompoint, not #svgpoint; Element to DOM #interface-element). Decided 2026-10-08. The rewrites from the old SVG WG host to w3c.github.io are intended and not pinned.
_comment_head_html: The <head> of the front page, the same as Bikeshed's own W3C header.include: the current W3C stylesheet and nothing from the old SVG 2 build (decided 2026-10-08). Bikeshed adds its built-in styles after it. MathML formulas are left to the browser, without MathJax.
